Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.execution

Class ActionExecution

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.execution.ActionExecution
@Component public class ActionExecution extends Object
Central orchestrator for executing GUI automation actions with full lifecycle management.

This class implements the action execution layer of the model-based GUI automation framework, handling the complete lifecycle of an action from initialization through completion. It provides a consistent execution environment for BasicActionRegistry operations while managing critical cross-cutting concerns.

Key responsibilities:

  • Action timing: Records start time, duration, and enforces configured pauses
  • Lifecycle management: Controls action sequences, repetitions, and termination conditions
  • Success determination: Evaluates action outcomes based on configured criteria
  • Logging and reporting: Captures execution details for debugging and analysis
  • Screenshot illustration: Documents visual state before/after actions when enabled
  • Dataset collection: Captures training data for machine learning when enabled

The execution flow follows these steps:

  1. Initialize ActionResult with action parameters
  2. Apply pre-action pause if configured
  3. Execute action sequences until lifecycle conditions are met
  4. Determine success based on results and criteria
  5. Capture illustrations if enabled
  6. Apply post-action pause if configured
  7. Log results and collect training data if applicable

Design note: Any action executed outside this class must implement equivalent lifecycle management to ensure consistent behavior across the framework.

  • Constructor Details

    • ActionExecution

      public ActionExecution(BrobotProperties brobotProperties, TimeWrapper timeWrapper, IllustrationController illustrateScreenshot, SearchRegionResolver selectRegions, ActionLifecycleManagement actionLifecycleManagement, DatasetManager datasetManager, ActionSuccessCriteria success, ActionResultFactory matchesInitializer, ScreenshotCapture captureScreenshot, @Autowired(required=false) ExecutionController executionController, BrobotLogger brobotLogger, StateMemory stateMemory, @Autowired(required=false) ActionLogFormatter actionLogFormatter, @Autowired(required=false) LoggingConfiguration loggingConfiguration)
      Constructs an ActionExecution instance with all required dependencies.

      This constructor uses dependency injection to wire together the various components needed for comprehensive action execution. Each dependency handles a specific aspect of the execution lifecycle.

      Parameters:
      brobotProperties - Configuration properties for the framework
      timeWrapper - Provides timing services including wait operations and duration tracking
      illustrateScreenshot - Captures and annotates screenshots for visual documentation
      selectRegions - Identifies screen regions relevant to the action
      actionLifecycleManagement - Controls action repetition, sequences, and termination
      datasetManager - Collects training data when machine learning mode is enabled
      success - Evaluates and sets success criteria for completed actions
      matchesInitializer - Creates and configures ActionResult instances
      captureScreenshot - Captures raw screenshots for error documentation
      executionController - Controls execution flow with pause/resume/stop functionality
      brobotLogger - Logger for framework-level events
      stateMemory - State management and history
      actionLogFormatter - Formatter for concise action logging
      loggingConfiguration - Logging configuration for checking enabled levels

  • Method Details

    • perform

      public ActionResult perform(ActionInterface actionMethod, String actionDescription, ActionConfig actionConfig, ObjectCollection... objectCollections)
      Executes an action with complete lifecycle management using ActionConfig.

      This method is the new primary entry point that accepts ActionConfig instead of ActionConfig. It provides the same comprehensive lifecycle management as the legacy method but uses the modern configuration approach.

      Parameters:
      actionMethod - The ActionInterface implementation containing action-specific logic
      actionDescription - Human-readable description of the action for logging and ML training
      actionConfig - Configuration parameters controlling action behavior and success criteria
      objectCollections - Variable number of ObjectCollection containing target GUI elements
      Returns:
      ActionResult containing matches found, success status, duration, and execution details
